IMySqlBinlogStatusClient.cs.reason: Internal interface with no executable lines; exercised through the hand-written fake in the connector unit tests.

MySqlBinlogStatusClient.cs.reason: Runs SHOW BINARY LOG STATUS against a server; the result reading (ReadPositionAsync) is unit-tested through a DataTable-backed DbDataReader, and the connection/command lines need MySQL 8.4/9.x (integration tests: #3052)

justifications.unit: ReadPositionAsync runs against a real DbDataReader built from a DataTable (row, empty result, null/missing column, cancellation) and the constructor and the cancelled-connect path run too, measured 63.16%; the connection open, command creation and reader execution need a live MySQL (#3052).
justifications.guard: Guard tests execute the constructor ThrowIfNull line through reflection (measured 21.05%); the remaining lines are covered by the unit flag.
justifications.integration: Integration tests run every line against real MySQL 8.4 and 9.x servers (measured 100%), including the empty result of a server without binary logging.

MySqlCdcConnector.cs.reason: CDC connector: GetCurrentPositionAsync is unit tested through the IMySqlBinlogStatusClient seam; position reads and the insert streaming path run on real MySQL 8.4 and 9.x in the integration tests (#3052); update/delete mapping and reconnect branches are left to #2839.

justifications.unit: GetCurrentPositionAsync and the constructor run through a hand-written fake of IMySqlBinlogStatusClient (row, empty result, throwing, cancelled), measured 19.51%; StreamChangesAsync and the event mapping need a live binlog.
justifications.guard: Guard tests execute the four constructor ThrowIfNull lines (measured 10.98%).
justifications.integration: Integration tests on real MySQL 8.4 and 9.x run GetCurrentPositionAsync and the streaming path of an insert (measured 63.4%); update and delete mapping, table-map eviction and reconnect branches are left to the larger sibling #2839.
